description:
Relaxing Music | Bansuri & Tanpura for Deep Sleep | 1.5 Hours

If your body is exhausted but your mind won't stop — start here. This is the classical Indian pairing that's helped people sleep for centuries: bamboo flute over a slow drone. Let it carry you in.

90 minutes of slow bansuri and tanpura, tuned to a gentle low frequency designed to bring the body into deep sleep.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Bansuri — the bamboo flute, breath-driven and warm
- Tanpura — the slow drone underneath, the hypnotic foundation of every Indian classical performance
- A gentle low-frequency layer for the nervous system to release
- Unbroken sound — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — body softening into the surface
12:00  Drone holding, breath finding rhythm
30:00  Mind quieting
60:00  Deep sleep zone
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Lights low. Don't try to sleep — let the flute and drone do the work. Phone face down, somewhere out of reach.

⏱ Best for:
• Stress-induced insomnia
• Wired-but-tired evenings
• End-of-week mental decompression
• Long sleep-through-the-night sessions
• Pre-sleep wind-down ritual

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate gold-and-cream patterned border with subtle lotus and moon motifs, aged warm parchment background, late-evening palette (deep indigo with single warm oil lamp glow, soft moonlight through window). Central figure: a serene woman in deep-burgundy-and-cream sari with gold accents seated cross-legged playing bansuri (bamboo flute) with a tanpura (long-necked drone instrument) standing nearby, both visible. Quiet candle-lit room. Single sleeping figure curled in a low bed nearby OR a still water bowl reflecting moonlight as visual sleep-cue. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'INTO DEEP SLEEP' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Aged warm cream parchment palette, contemplative restful mood, single composed scene, no clutter. NOTE for Variant B: same scene but overlay text 'CORTISOL OVERLOAD?' instead.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Bansuri (bamboo flute) lead over slow continuous tanpura drone, in raga Yaman, deep evening sleep mood. Bansuri plays slow contemplative melodic phrases with natural breathing pauses and long sustained notes. Tanpura provides hypnotic continuous tonic-fifth drone underneath. No percussion, no tabla, no other melodic instruments. 174Hz tuning. 55-60 BPM very slow tempo. Sustained drone-resolving phrases with natural breathing pauses. Cinematic meditation production, deeply grounding and sleep-inducing. Suitable for extended looping in post-production. Begins immediately with bansuri and tanpura already in motion, no fade-in, no silent intro, full sonic presence from first note. deeply settled, like a body finally surrendering to rest

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1 settled · clip 2 introspective · clip 3 hopeful · clips 4-7 cycle. Yaman tonic D. CRITICAL: This is a MIX-INSTRUMENT ship (Bansuri lead + Tanpura drone). In Suno prompt emphasize 'bansuri lead over slow continuous tanpura drone' — Suno may default to just one instrument. Mix: Suno -3dB, Binaural -22dB (very quiet for sleep), Tanpura should be PRESENT in mix (not just background drone — part of the title promise). LUFS target -16dB (quieter than usual healing ships — viewers will play while falling asleep).
